div.head: ECf 21.1
div.ab: Quodsi ipsi forisfacerent, et clamor uicinorum insurgeret de eis, ipsi haberent eos ad rectum in curia sua, si haberent sacha and sochne et tol et team et infangeneþeof.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 647 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

div.ab: And if these committed an offence, and the outcry of the neighbours rose against them, they should have them to right in their court, if they had sake and soke (sacha and sochne) and toll and team (tol et team) and infangentheof (infangeneþeof, the right to judge a thief taken within the estate).

note.seg: Zwar hat jeder baro Vassallen, aber nicht jeder private Gerichtsbarkeit; s. d. Gl 26b; infangenþeof 7f.; Privileg 2. Besitzt er sie nicht, so hat er sein Gefolge vors öffentliche Gericht zu stellen oder für sie zu haften; s. Gl Polizei 1J

Every baro has vassals, it is true, but not every one has private jurisdiction; see that word in Gl 26b; infangenþeof 7f.; Privileg 2. If he does not possess it, he must bring his following before the public court or be liable for them; see Gl Polizei 1J
